raw_blocks: Making the World a Healthier Place .
At Balchem, we are committed to making the world a healthier place by delivering trusted, innovative, and science-based solutions to the nutrition, health, and food markets.
Improving Life for All .
At Balchem Human Nutrition and Health, we offer solutions that nourish your body and delight your senses—from essential nutrition to sensory-rich experiences.
Meeting Animal Nutrition Needs .
With a growing portfolio of products and a dedication to innovation and sustainability, Animal Nutrition & Health is leading the charge to meet the nutritional needs of animals.
Consisting of our Performance Gases and Plant Nutrition businesses, Specialty Products complements our vision of making the world a healthier place.
Who We Are: About Balchem.

For over five decades, Balchem has created innovative health and nutritional solutions for people and animals worldwide. Our diverse portfolio impacts millions, offering quality and technology that help our customers succeed. Balchem operates in three segments: Human Nutrition & Health, Animal Nutrition & Health, and Specialty Products.
Our Human Nutrition & Health business leverages decades of expertise in market insights, proven science, and product development to create winning solutions in health, wellbeing, and nutrition.

As a global leader of choline production and encapsulation technology, our Animal Nutrition & Health business provides a portfolio of nutrition products for ruminants, monogastrics, and companion animals.
Our Performance Gases specializes in the packaging and global distribution of select gases. Our Plant Nutrition business provides Metalosate® chelated minerals to the agricultural market worldwide.

At Balchem, innovation drives us to make the world a healthier place. Our R&D expertise fuels business growth and solves tough challenges. With eight Innovation Centers in the US and Europe, we create hundreds of new products annually. Discover our core technologies.

Balchem is a publicly-traded company listed on the NASDAQ under BCPC. Explore our Investor Relations section to learn about our goals and strategies to support your investment decision and increase long-term shareholder value.

Great solutions start with a problem and a solver. At Balchem, we value good ideas and seek talented individuals worldwide who are passionate about science and problem-solving. Explore our Career section to learn more and view current opportunities.

Animal Nutrition and Health .
We are dedicated to innovation & industry sustainability, while leading the charge to meet the nutritional needs of ruminants, monogastrics & companion animals.
Real People. Real Science. Real Results.

Balchem Animal Nutrition & Health is the global leader in c holine production, nutrient encapsulation , chelated minerals and functional ingredients . With a growing portfolio of products and a dedication to innovation and industry sustainability, Balchem Animal Nutrition & Health is leading the charge to meet the nutritional needs of ruminants, swine, poultry, aquaculture and companion animals. Our product solutions work to fulfill the unique needs of various animal species including nutrition, gut health, and feed quality. We also understand that due to animal diversity and the ever-shifting environment in which they’re raised, no animal or situation is the same. Together, we can solve the animal nutritional challenges of today to shape a better tomorrow.

Balchem Animal Nutrition & Health is a leader in innovative, sustainable solutions for animal nutrition, addressing the unique dietary needs of both ruminant and monogastric animals. Committed to advancing industry sustainability, Balchem provides cutting-edge nutrition solutions that support animal health and improve production efficiency.

Balchem is a global leader in encapsulation, mineral chelation, and choline production, pioneering innovative precision technologies to improve efficiency and effectiveness. Through continuous research investments, Balchem drives advancements that define the future of sustainable and high-performance solutions in animal nutrition.

Balchem is honored to bring you the Real Faces of Dairy project. The Real Faces of Dairy continues to increase awareness of the passion and commitment dairy producers, and industry enthusiasts share. Join the cause by sharing your dairy story with consumers and help show the world how much we care for our animals, our land and the legacy we leave behind.

Meet the people behind Balchem’s vision and mission. Our leadership team has dedicated countless hours to positioning the company for growth and success. Their passion inspires our employees to tackle today’s problems, helping to create a healthier tomorrow.

Balchem was founded in 1967 by a group consisting of entrepreneurs, investors, and Dr. Leslie Balassa, an expert in the field of encapsulation. The company was initially housed in a laboratory on the top floor of the Chemists Club in New York City until purchasing its first manufacturing site, a former dairy in Slate Hill, New York. Balchem became a publicly traded company in 1970 and is listed on NASDAQ under the symbol “BCPC.”

Balchem has grown by developing unique technologies, by identifying novel applications for our science, and by acquiring new synergistic technologies and capabilities. All growth strategies are centered around our vision of making the world a healthier place.

At Balchem, s ustainability is a key pillar of our company’s vision to make the world a healthier place . W e are dedicated to operating and innovating for a sustainable future, focusing on Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) topics through three primary pillars: People, Planet, and Profit .

By harnessing the collective efforts of our employees, Balchem gives back to the local communities where we operate and provides a helping hand to those in need through our corporate giving and employee volunteering initiatives.
At Balchem, we are committed to a company culture of belonging . Our diversity is a catalyst for innovation and operational excellence.
